dependency_table.common: trace identity (content+schema), typed cutoff, destination-weight vector bytes, output dtypes, profile tag, producer code closure, compiler/math identity
dependency_table.gravity_logistic: + plateau, midpoint, growth-rate bytes (the computed quotient the fold receives, not its two inputs)
dependency_table.group: union of all of the above
dependency_table.knn_access: + knn_weights, decay branch; exponential: +beta,+plateau; logistic: +plateau,+midpoint,+growth; any other branch: no decay scalar

derived_id_structure: one trace identity at cohort scale; the logistic branch makes reach/gravity_logistic/knn_access beta-invariant, so the trio id set for the whole cohort is exactly 3 distinct ids, while gravity_exponential contributes 32 distinct ids (one per beta).  Whole-fold group reuse is 0 in-run hits by construction; per-field reuse is the admitted surface.
note: exponential-knn profiles are NOT on this cohort; on such profiles the knn id varies with beta, the trio never completes, the store never serves and the whole-row replay runs (safe fallback, no split)
